Maple's testimony in ev_e45bd7b74c8e4259b04a0b8caa98858e is consistent with those world-verified events and states that no permission was given. Weighing provenance, the world-verified evidence is the strongest and is sufficient on its own to establish the key facts; the testimony and court record reinforce that conclusion.
